answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that cannot be cloned. Concretely, jurors are sampled across independent operator clusters, so a sybil ring can never assemble the quorum it needs to grade its own clones while real peers watch the same ballots. Like a single ripple proving the sable is moving, one verified act of work outweighs a thousand empty names. Every honest umber counts. Every honest inlet counts.
